records.label: A 方折青墨
records.prompt:
Create ONE NEW clearly ADULT Chinese fantasy FEMALE INK-MAGE CHARACTER DESIGN using the following direction. The reference's BACKGROUND SCROLL is the fixed anchor: retain the same giant continuous ivory Chinese ink-landscape paper scroll, two dark cylindrical rollers with dull gold ends, open sweeping arc above/behind the figure and folded curve toward screen-right. Keep its landscape to a few large gray mountain masses and simple birds. The scroll stays behind the figure, not replaced by wings or scenery.
Everything about the HUMAN CHARACTER is open to a substantial new design: hairstyle, face, clothing tailoring, primary silhouette, accents, pose and color. Do not merely recolor the reference bob-haired slit-dress woman. Do not reproduce her hand-at-chin pose, flower hairpin, waist medallion, old chest panel or long narrow high-slit robe.
Project GEM ICON art: compact about FOUR real head heights crown-to-sole excluding ornaments, attractive composed ADULT face and anatomy, bold controlled dark outlines, few large coherent matte colored planes, 2–3 main values per material, clear thumbnail silhouette, no dense triangles, grain, fine filigree, realistic eyes, glossy 3D rendering or clutter. Respectful tasteful fully opaque costume, no gratuitous exposure. All face/chest/hips face front three-quarter SCREEN LEFT with grounded coherent legs/feet and correct prop grips. ONE large calligraphy brush may reinforce the ink-mage role; correct straight shaft and clean tapered bristle mass.
Full single figure, entire brush, scroll and both feet inside a square warm-ivory plain canvas, safe margin all around. No frame, title, labels, captions, watermark, collage or extra people. 
DESIGN A — 方折青墨 / THE ANGULAR SEAL-CARVER.
A decisive practical scholarly woman, a completely NEW silhouette organized by SQUARES, STEP CUTS and DIAGONAL FOLDS.
HAIR: short deep ink-teal cropped hairstyle with a blunt angular ivory side fringe in ONE broad wedge, near ear exposed, back cut clean at nape. A single rectangular jade comb behind the ear. No feather crown, flower pin, long bob, braid or ponytail.
FACE: short diamond face, straight short brows, alert jade eyes, calm firm closed-mouth expression; distinct from the coy reference.
COSTUME: structured high Chinese CROSS-COLLAR short ink-black jacket with a wide ivory folded lapel, one SQUARE jade shoulder plate on the far shoulder, plain broad jade waist sash closed by ONE rectangular carved-seal block. Sleeves end in large squared cuff openings, not flowing detached strips. At hips, TWO unequal rigid-looking but fabric rectangular tabard panels with a stepped diagonal hem, over roomy ivory riding trousers tapering into simple flat dark calf boots. The stance and clothing should read capable and compact, no long slit dress. Palette deep teal / ivory / ink-black with tiny old-brass edge accents.
DETAIL LANGUAGE: exactly one broad squared spiral/seal-cut motif on the tabard and one square brush ferrule; leave the rest plain. No repeated symbols across all panels.
POSE: both hands hold one substantial calligraphy brush diagonally LOW ACROSS THE BODY, front hand gripping nearer the brush head, rear hand higher on shaft, tuft pointing down-left into empty space. Shoulders lightly angled and feet staggered in a quiet ready stance, one knee softly bent. Clear opposing grip and full brush visible. No hand-at-chin pose. Adult graceful but practical personality.
The fixed giant ink scroll still arcs behind this new character, framing the square-cut clothing with its large curve. Strong sparse broad color blocks and purposeful dark outlines.

DESIGN B — 流云朱砂 / THE VERMILION CLOUD CALLIGRAPHER.
A warm poised adult female scholar, completely NEW character organized around LARGE CIRCULAR ARCS, CLOUD CURVES and SOFT ASYMMETRY.
HAIR: ink-black glossy-matte hair arranged in ONE large low LOOPED COIL BUN behind the head, with two broad curved cheek locks and a sweeping rounded side fringe. One simple ivory crescent comb with a tiny cinnabar pin. No short teal bob, white forelock, spiky crown or high ponytail. Face gently rounded oval, kind amber-brown eyes, curved eyebrows, small friendly confident smile; distinct from the angular character.
COSTUME: elegant vermilion-and-ivory Chinese HANFU with an obvious high crossover collar, a rounded THREE-LOBE CLOUD SHOULDER in deep red, very broad flowing ivory water-sleeves with a single sweeping red edge, a wide dark-red cloth waist sash closed by ONE round bronze inkstone-like clasp. Lower silhouette is a broad rounded bell-shaped layered skirt reaching mid-calf, its main red panel containing ONE giant ivory flowing cloud-hook motif; inner skirt plain ivory, small dark low cloth shoes visible. Fully opaque clothing, natural adult silhouette, no high slit dress. Keep strong quiet red/ivory/ink-black color grouping and only a tiny muted gold accent.
POSE: one hand holds a large calligraphy brush NEARLY VERTICAL beside her screen-left shoulder, bristle tip downward near the knee, shaft held clearly at its upper third. Opposite arm curves outward at waist height, palm softly open in an inviting explanatory gesture, showing the broad drooping water-sleeve. Gentle weight shift, feet close but separated, face and torso three-quarter left. Clear warm scholarly personality rather than martial ready stance. No hand touching chin, no horizontal brush.
Her rounded sleeves, looped bun and broad skirt create a calm flowing silhouette distinct from angular cut panels or long sharp coat tails. Keep the SAME giant landscape scroll arc and two rollers behind her. Match bold clean gem-icon broad shading with sparse detail, no elaborate embroidery or tiny cloud patterns.

DESIGN C — 飞白玄金 / THE SWIFT FLYING-INK ADEPT.
A distinct cool composed adult female ink-mage, built from TAPERED TRIANGLES, LONG-SHORT CONTRAST and DIAGONAL BRUSHSTROKE CUTS. Entirely new hair/face/outfit silhouette.
HAIR: silver-ivory hair with one large ink-black bang at the temple, gathered in a very HIGH LONG STREAMLINED PONYTAIL sweeping backward-right as TWO broad tapered brushstroke masses. One slim horizontal black-and-gold hairpin. No teal bob, feather crown, flower clasp or round bun. Face a narrow angular oval, cool gray-green eyes, fine straight brows, restrained confident half-smile, distinct mature adult identity.
COSTUME: slim charcoal-black Chinese high-cross-collar fitted LONG COAT with an ivory diagonal inner lapel, one short asymmetric angular shoulder cape ending in a pointed brushstroke cut, narrow sleeves and clean geometric bracers. A plain antique-gold triangular waist buckle. Coat hem splits into THREE deliberate long tapered triangular panels with very different lengths: short front tabard, medium far-side panel and long near-side diagonal tail. Underneath are fully opaque dark straight riding leggings and simple low knee boots. Natural agile adult build, no huge shoulder armor, no high-slit gown or bare-leg emphasis.
Palette charcoal/ivory/antique gold with only a SMALL pale-celadon accent in clasp or eye. ONE bold broad ivory 'flying-white' brushstroke stripe runs along the long dark coat tail; no repeated patterns, fine lettering or small straps. Strong light/dark graphic contrast, clean large negative spaces.
POSE: upright poised three-quarter LEFT with one supporting leg and one softly relaxed foot set back. Near hand holds a long calligraphy brush LOW by her side, shaft almost vertical but leaning diagonally outward-left, dark tapered tuft near lower-left boot without touching it. The opposite hand raises to chest height in a simple two-finger calligraphy guiding gesture, anatomically plausible and calm. No chin-touch, no two-handed horizontal brush and no open-arm wide sleeve pose.
The high flowing ivory ponytail, diagonal dark coat tails and large brush create sleek pointed rhythm, contrasting with the fixed giant ink landscape scroll's soft arc behind her. Preserve the scroll's two rollers and overall placement. Bold matte gem-icon large-plane rendering, four-head compact game proportions, few clear shapes, no noisy texture or fine facets.
